paragraphs: Levi bar Shemuel (the son of Abba bar Abba), the priest, in Rav Yehudah's time. His brothers: Rav Pappa, Rabbah, and Rami. Levi bar Shemuel read before Rav Yehudah, Megillah (19, end of side a). He and Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya were preparing the cloth covers of the books in Rav Yehudah's house; when they reached the scroll of Esther, Sanhedrin (100a). He found R. Abba and Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya standing at the entrance to Rav Huna's house, etc., and came before Rav Yehudah, Shabbat (47a).
